svg.text: Mutations in “CRC” by protein position, as cBioPortal's mutation tab draws them: one stem per codon (the stored protein start position), its height the
number of distinct patient + protein change pairs there. Colour is the codon's dominant mutation type, putative drivers before VUS (driver = OncoKB
oncogenic, pinned; the portal also counts hotspots and custom annotations). VUS and germline mutations are included, as they are by default on the portal. A
suppression floor of 3 patients per change was applied BY EACH SITE before returning anything, withholding 1,112 mutations. KRAS: somatic mutation
frequency 42.5%; mutation rows missense 2,365 driver / 3 VUS, inframe 5 driver / 0 VUS. BRAF: somatic mutation frequency 11.2%; mutation rows
missense 520 driver / 8 VUS, truncating 0 driver / 19 VUS. PIK3CA: somatic mutation frequency 20.5%; mutation rows missense 1,036 driver / 41 VUS,
truncating 0 driver / 8 VUS, inframe 14 driver / 0 VUS. TP53: somatic mutation frequency 73.2%; mutation rows missense 2,628 driver / 26 VUS, truncating
796 driver / 0 VUS, inframe 30 driver / 0 VUS, splice 244 driver / 0 VUS.
